newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunker prices pushed down by lower crude.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunker prices pushed down by lower crude.

text.p: ARA bunker prices slid lower on Friday despite fairly healthy demand as prompt benchmark IPE Brent futures fell below the crucial $20 level, pulling the physical oil complex in its wake.
Rotterdam 380 CST eased to $90/$92 fob against $94/$96, while 180 CST was quoted some $8 above this.
"It's been a fairly good week," said one broker. "Prices are just off in line with the falls in crude prices."
Hamburg prices followed ARA lower with 380 CST put at $97/$99 and 180 CST at $103/$105.
Mediterranean prices were little changed in a quiet market.
Augusta 380 CST was quoted at $110/$112 while in Algeciras it was put at $103/$104.
Piraeus 380 CST was quoted at $102/$104 in a quiet close to the week.
Many brokers in both the ARA and Mediterranean thought business would pick up next week with the return of many brokers to the market after attending industry functions in London.
Bunker prices in Durban were slightly lower at $98/$100 for 180 CST.
